body: IGN and Best Buy’s three weeks of giveaways are coming to an end, with the final grand prize being the Desk Upgrade bundle. It has a 27-Inch Alienware OLED Gaming Monitor, GTPlayer Gaming Chair, Logitech A50 Wireless Headset, and GTA VI’s soundtrack on vinyl. Presented by. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
